selection: calibration TRAIN only; nested student thresholds inside image-router folds; image-group OOF quality predictions for word-router tuning
scope: Research extension; word router runs both experts, image router simulates selective fallback using frozen cached outputs

scientific_decisions.rationale: TP gain minus half the training-fold DeepSolo F1 times extra emitted predictions; penalizes FP and rewards recovered FN on a common word metric.
Shared frozen priors historically trained on official TRAIN; newly trained slot branches exclude calibration/evaluation. OOF gates do not constitute a fresh independent dataset.
Cached branch selection measures word outcomes and logical calls, not end-to-end selective process latency.
